verdict.rationale: SAM.gov publishes a broad family of documented public REST APIs: Entity Management, Opportunities with pagination, Exclusions, Contracts, Federal Hierarchy and Assistance Listings. They offer rich query parameters, JSON/CSV output, documented API-key and system-account access, and an OpenAPI spec file on the Entity API page. Probes found no OpenAPI file at generic guessed paths, but that does not contradict the documented downloadable spec. Missing for 10: no evidence of write/action endpoints (e.g., performing registration via API), so this is retrieval-oriented rather than full product control; key access is gated behind a SAM.gov account and system-account approval; there are no AI-friendly doc affordances (llms.txt and markdown docs return 404); and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
